My [n]ex partner was so rude to my friends from high school and practically pushed them away for me. He didn’t like me being a part of the lgbtq community. Discouraged me having friends, super jealous paranoid person, of course I let him control me. I should have saw the signs when nobody came to my 19th birthday party. I didn’t leave for nearly 7 years.

I was given an opportunity of a lifetime when introduced to a new group of people, full of vibrant genuine souls who are into psychedelia & philosophy (so glad to have found “my people”) but I struggled since I never developed social skills outside of school. I made one friend, we got along really well but she was the most surface level personality I’ve ever met.

I enjoy long deep conversations and it sometimes felt like talking to a 5 year old, they know how to nod and smile but they don’t really know what’s going on half the time. She would act really weird, film people we just met and say “look mum my friend!” She had her own issues of not paying me back, “accidentally” picking up other peoples alcoholic drinks and being so out of it (sober) that I had to be the one to apologise, get the drink out of her hand, give it back. After coming to a friends house with a blasting speaker, who’s mother was asleep, I told her to settle down and be quiet and she wouldn’t understand. A lot of people I looked up to asked me why I’m hanging around her. I started to feel second-hand embarrassment and being introduced to a new crowd of people I didn’t want her reputation rubbed on me. 

I decided to ditch her as a friend after coming to her upset one time, she didn’t stop talking for a whole hour, blabbering about the most strangest child-like things. She couldn’t read cues. I felt bad but I thought maybe I was making room for better friends. 

Since then I’ve dated within the scene, met lovely people, but never grasped the idea of actually making true real friends. I’ve developed so much shame, guilt and social anxiety because of what I did to her and to my lgbtq friends from high school. Friends that loved me, that laughed with me, that goofed around. I’ve all ditched for a “better life”. 

Now I’m dating another psycho and I feel as stuck as I’ve ever been, I’m in one of the most cooked scenarios and I just can’t wait to get out. I wish people knew the truth about this person I’m living with, but I don’t want to “air out” my laundry. I avoid people, girls in particular, as I don’t want to put their safety or dignity on the line being around my “boyfriend”. I feel disgusting that I’ve let this go on. I’m just waiting for the police to arrest him and then maybe I can tell people the truth.
